scope: Correct acceptance assertions and recovery clocks; case-specific budgets without changing production policy.

threshold_policy.legacy_900ms: max_speech_start_to_resume_ms for brief-backchannel cases; includes the user speech duration. Original numeric thresholds retained.
threshold_policy.new_optional_metric: max_speech_stop_to_resume_ms, configured per case; excludes user speech duration. No new runtime timeout or user profiling.
threshold_policy.slow_or_paused_speech: Protect continuation and one complete commit. Longer continuation tolerance does not automatically justify longer reply latency after completion or slower initial attenuation.
threshold_policy.reply_gate: Existing 2500 ms reply objective added as a necessary server VAD-stop to same-request TTS-first-audio gate in the three continuation cases. Does not certify receiver or physical speaker latency.

changes: All canonical_contains fragments must appear in one text, not across turns or fields.
canonical_response_required binds complete canonical text to ordered same-turn commit, RPC, answer delta and TTS first audio.
No configured latency gate produces experience_slo_passed=null / not_evaluated, with report counts separate from failures.
Application output recovery events carry an operation timestamp, contemporaneous stop boundary and user_speaking flag. Later candidate resolution cannot substitute for provisional recovery.
Removed mandatory minimum waits from the prior diagnostic scenario; timing remains recorded and incomplete-turn guards remain.
negative_tests: Split canonical across different turns or fields.
Missing commit, answer delta or reply audio.
Audio timestamp precedes request; only another request produces audio.
Configured reply deadline fails despite functional success; missing reply also fails.
Identical 200 ms recovery overhead after 300 ms versus 2 s speech: stop-relative budget passes both; legacy 900 ms onset-relative budget still fails the longer sample.
Missing timestamp on provisional recovery cannot be replaced by a later terminal verdict.
architecture: Production change is recovery-event metadata only in FullDuplexInterruptionEffects; other runtime behavior files match prior validated hashes. No SDK, model, mode, timer or user-profile policy change.
limits: Receiver frames are not yet attributed to the new reply; canonical_reply_receiver_status remains not_measured. after_user_done continues to mean only some audio arrived after input.
The full end-user delay starts earlier than server VAD stop and ends later than application TTS; the new 2500 ms gate is only a necessary stage check.
Long ongoing speech can still trigger existing provisional recovery after its budget; now observable, not declared a good experience.
No deployment or mobile/OPI5 Max speaker retest. Original two response-latency gaps remain.

One initial instrumentation assertion expected interrupt_resolved_at after candidate-only expiry; that mark does not exist there. The corrected test uses existing owner events. No runtime behavior was changed for this test error.
